```{r}
library(tidyverse)
penguins <- read_csv(file="data/penguin_dataset.csv")
```

```{r}
penguins |> count(body_mass)
penguins |> count(body_mass) |> arrange()
```

```{r}
penguins |> relocate(year, .after=island)
```

```{r}
#1
penguins |> arrange(body_mass)

#2
penguins |> arrange(desc(flipper_len))

#3
penguins |> arrange(species,bill_len)

#4
penguins |> relocate(species,bill_len,bill_dep,flipper_len,body_mass)
# or alternatively
penguins |> relocate(island, .after=body_mass)

# additional info:
# penguins |> relocate(contains("body"))

#5
penguins |> relocate(year, .after=last_col())
```

```{r}
penguins |> arrange(desc(body_mass)) |> relocate(island, .after=body_mass)
```

```{r}
#1
penguins |> filter(species == "Adelie") |> count()

#2
(penguins |> count(island))[[1,1]]
# or
names(which.max(table(penguins$island)))

#3
penguins |> filter(species == "Gentoo" & body_mass > 5000)

#4
penguins |> filter(sex == "female" | sex == "male") |> count()

#5
penguins |> filter(body_mass < 3500 & bill_len < 35) |> count()
```

```{r}
penguins |> select(contains("_"))
#or
penguins |> select(starts_with("b") | starts_with("f"))
```

```{r}
penguins |> distinct(species,island)
penguins |> filter(body_mass > 4000) |>  distinct(species,sex)
penguins |> filter(species == "Gentoo" & island == "Biscoe") |> distinct(year) |> count()
```

```{r}
penguins |> mutate(body_mass_kg = body_mass/1000)
penguins |> mutate(flipper_to_mass_ratio = flipper_len/body_mass) |> arrange(desc(flipper_to_mass_ratio))
penguins |> mutate(heavy = body_mass > 4500)
```

```{r}
penguins_new =
    mutate(penguins, size = case_when(
    flipper_len < 190 & body_mass < 4000  ~ "small",
    flipper_len > 210 & body_mass > 5000 ~ "big",
    TRUE ~ "medium"
  ))
ggplot(data = penguins_new,
      mapping = aes(x = flipper_len,
                     y = body_mass,
                     colour = size)) +
    geom_point()

# or alternatively

penguins |> 
    mutate(size = case_when(
    flipper_len < 190 & body_mass < 4000  ~ "small",
    flipper_len > 210 & body_mass > 5000 ~ "big",
    TRUE ~ "medium"
  )) |> 
ggplot(mapping = aes(x = flipper_len,
                     y = body_mass,
                     colour = size)) +
    geom_point()
```

```{r}
penguins |> group_by(species,island) |> summarize(mean_body_mass = mean(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
penguins |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  filter(body_mass == min(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE))
```
